newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian August house materials prices rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian August house materials prices rise.

text.p: Australian house building materials prices rose 0.2 percent in August from the previous month, and were 0.4 percent lower than a year before, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
Other building materials prices also rose 0.2 percent in the month, for a 0.4 percent annual increase.
The bureau said the rise in the price index for materials used in house-building was due mainly to higher raw materials costs for reinforcing steel products.
"This was partly offset by price falls for plaster products and structural timber," the bureau said.
The index, at 115.7, was at its highest point since 115.8 in October last year.
The bureau said the increase in the non-housing materials index was due mainly to higher prices for steel-based materials, partly offset by a fall for ready-mixed concrete prices.
